item.coloph: zhes pa bla chen bka' lung 'di/ stang chen dmu tsha gyer med kyis/ mkha' 'gro 'od ldan 'bar ma brgyud/ des nas rnga yab zangs mdog rir/ g.yung drung thogs med bdag la brgyud/ bka' rgya grol nas spel dgos dus/ zhig mchog bla mas gsung bskul phyir/ bsam 'grub nor bu'i gling du bris/ nyes 'gal mchis na mkha' 'gror bshags/ dge bas 'gro la phan thog shog/
